legend: You are given an n×m$$$n \times m$$$ table, consisting of characters «A», «G», «C», «T». Let's call a table nice, if every 2×2$$$2 \times 2$$$ square contains all four distinct characters. Your task is to find a nice table (also consisting of «A», «G», «C», «T»), that differs from the given table in the minimum number of characters.
input: First line contains two positive integers n$$$n$$$ and m$$$m$$$ — number of rows and columns in the table you are given (2≤n,m,n×m≤300000$$$2 \leq n, m, n \times m \leq 300\,000$$$). Then, n$$$n$$$ lines describing the table follow. Each line contains exactly m$$$m$$$ characters «A», «G», «C», «T».
output: Output n$$$n$$$ lines, m$$$m$$$ characters each. This table must be nice and differ from the input table in the minimum number of characters.
note: In the first sample, the table is already nice. In the second sample, you can change 9 elements to make the table nice.
